MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 43
   C. 31
   D. 41

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

4. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 9
   C. 13
   D. 21

   A. 12

   C. 33

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36

   C. 12
   D. 42

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

16. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 57

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
